title.narrative: Stöd till 2020 Befolkning och boende CENSUS
Support to 2022 Population and Housing Census

description.narrative: Insatsen kommer att bidra till INSTATs genomförande av folk- och bostadsräkningen 2022. Sidas bidrag kommer att täcka en del av aktiviteterna inom ramen för folk-och bostadsräkningen. Insatsen kompletterar Sveriges 20-åriga stöd till Albanien inom statistikområdet. Folk-och bostadsräkningen som ska genomföras under 2022, kommer att ge en bild av den albanska befolkningen; information som är viktig för att kunna planera och fatta beslut på ett realistiskt sätt. Dessutom kommer den att ge en betydelsefull översikt av de albanska hushållens ekonomiska och sociala situation. Folk-och bostadsräkningen är ett mycket stort program med en budget på cirka 16.9 MEUR och Sverige kommer att ge ett delbidrag (cirka 9 % av budgeten) tillsammans med andra finansiärer som den albanska regeringen (drygt 55 %) och EU-delegationen (cirka 28 %).

The contribution will assist INSTAT to conduct the 2022 Population and Housing Census. Sida contribution will cover some of the activities of the Census. The intervention complements the support of Sweden to the statistical system in Albania in almost 20 years. The registration of population and housing Census to be conducted in 2022 will provide a picture of the whole Albanian population with information important to realistically plan and take decisions. In addition, will provide important overview about the economic and social situation of Albanian households. Census is a huge intervention budgeted to about 16.9 MEUR and Sweden will provide a part of the support (about 9%) along other financer like Albanian Government ( about 55% ) and EU Delegation (about 28%).

The overall objective of the Population and Housing Census (PHC) 2022 is to provide the government and other stakeholders and the public with relevant statistical information on the social and demographical structure of the population in Albania and also contribute to the creation of a building and dwelling register and of population registers on the local and national level, which will be the source of annual Census statistics in the future. Specific Objectives of the project proposal is to support INSTAT conducting part of the Population and Housing Census 2022 by using technology more efficiently and effectively managed. The project proposal has been designed as financially support for the field work staff specifically controllers, support part of Publicity Campaign activities and provide external expertise for the preparation of the in-depth analyses of the Census results.

The Sida project, through a grant of 16.2 MSEK, is part of the total funding required to carry out the whole Population and Housing Census, alongside contributions from the Albanian government and other donors. Sida funding accounts for about 10% of the total Census budget, with Albanian government the main funder at 54%, followed by EU at 29% and SDC at 3%. The Sida funding supported part of Census activities throughout all phases of the Census, playing a key role in the successful data collection process, including communication activities, developing IT infrastructure, and preparing analyses based on the Census results. The Census was conducted nationwide, successfully gathering essential demographic and social data.The fieldwork began on September 18, 2023, and lasted six weeks, in accordance with the provisions of the Census Law. As the largest statistical activity, required the mobilization of approximately 7000 personnel across various roles and tasks, ensuring the collection of comprehensive data on the countrys population, housing conditions, and other demographic and socioeconomic characteristics through a door to door enumeration of population, building, and dwelling registration across the country over a sixweek period. A novel feature of this Census round was the new method of data collection using electronic devices, known as ComputerAssisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI), instead of the traditional Paper and Pencil Interviewing (PAPI) method. In this regard, 7700 tablets were used. This approach significantly sped up the data collection and processing process, while also improving data quality, as most logical control rules were built into the IT applications/devices. The preliminary Census results were published in June 2024.From June to December 2024, significant progress was made on the development of the Census quality report and the preparation of 12 detailed reports covering regional, municipal, and administrative unit levels, published by October 2024.
